summary.en: The world moves, the pointer does not: a scale tape crawls up to the old cap, the cap breaks, the tape sprints and brakes on a spring onto the new value under a fixed reading window.
summary.zh: 世界动、针不动：刻度带顶着旧上限慢爬，上限线断开，刻度带冲刺、弹簧刹车过冲回摆，停在新数值上，读数窗钉在画面中线不动。

fits: One metric that jumps (a limit raised, throughput multiplied): the size of the jump becomes distance and speed.
notFor: Small changes (the sprint has nothing to cover); several metrics at once (use needle-sweep).

intent.en: The size of the jump becomes distance and speed: the viewer feels how far the value went before reading the new number.
intent.zh: 跳变的大小变成路程和速度：观众先感到数值跑了多远，再读新数字。

content.en: One metric with its start, old cap and new value (the new several times the cap), a unit, a title (≤ 30 chars) and two cap labels (≤ 16 chars each); the claim is computed.
content.zh: 一个指标的起始值、旧上限和新值（新值是旧上限的几倍），单位、标题（≤ 14 字）和两个上限标签（每个 ≤ 7 字）；倍数自动算出。

fits.zh: 一个跳变的指标（上限提高、吞吐翻倍）：跳变大小变成路程和速度。

notFor.zh: 小幅变化（冲刺没有路可跑）；同时讲几个指标（用 needle-sweep）。

pairs.note: the several readings first, then the one that jumped

en: Only for a jump of several times; a small change has nothing for the sprint to cover.
Hold the tape dead still after the spring settles; any drift reads as a bug.
zh: 只配翻几倍的跳变，小变化让冲刺无路可跑。
弹簧停稳后刻度带锁死不动，尾漂像 bug。

upstream.name: 滚带定针
upstream.summary: 长刻度带 translate：慢爬段→45px/f 冲刺 ~25f→spring 刹车过冲回摆停位；窗内读数同步刷新
upstream.use: dashboard 开场仪式/性能指标揭晓；A 多表盘开机感，B 单指标大跳变

overlaps.note: a long page flicked through a window to a section; tape-run moves a measured scale and the reading is the position
a stream of lines braking on one item; tape-run brakes on a value
